_help: Lyrics shown top-left of the radar while a track plays. File name -> list of lines. Each line: t = when it starts (m:ss or seconds, position in the song file), mn = traditional Mongolian script (shown vertically), cyr = Mongolian Cyrillic, en = English. Leave a field empty to skip it. Lines are shown until the next line's time; add a line with all fields empty to clear the display (e.g. for an instrumental break).
